20 November 2026

To
The Grievance Redressal Officer
Axis Bank

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am reporting an unauthorised UPI payment of ₹18,500.00 dated 19 November 2026, bearing transaction reference 632377190455, debited from my account XXXX4410. I did not authorise this transaction and did not share any credentials.

This is my first report of this transaction to the bank. Please record it as reported today, acknowledge receipt, and take immediate steps to block further misuse of my account and the affected payment channel.

Responsibility for the unauthorised transaction has not yet been established. Under para 67(1) of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025 (RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, DOR.MCS.REC.No.89/01-01-032/2025-26), I am entitled to protection from customer liability where the transaction results from contributory fraud, negligence or deficiency on the bank's part. Under para 67(2) of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, protection from customer liability also applies to a third-party breach where the customer reports within the prescribed reporting window. Please assess this report accordingly. The indicated reporting deadline is 23 November 2026, subject to the home branch's working schedule under para 71 of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170.

Under para 75 of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, the burden of proving customer liability lies on the bank. Please investigate the transaction and provide the evidence and reasons supporting any finding on liability. Under para 68(1) of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, any loss occurring after I report the unauthorised transaction must be borne by the bank.

I request reversal of the disputed debit in accordance with the applicable liability rules and resolution within the prescribed timeline. Under para 73(1) of RBI/DOR/2025-26/170, the maximum resolution period is 90 days from receipt of this complaint. If you decline my request in whole or in part, please provide a reasoned written reply stating the applicable rules and supporting evidence.

I am also reporting this matter to the national cybercrime helpline and portal. Please provide a complaint acknowledgement and keep me informed of the investigation and action taken. If this complaint remains unresolved, I may escalate it to the RBI Ombudsman.

Yours faithfully,
[Your full name]
